fields.statement: QA at 8ff82f55d: built tools/release (go build -trimpath) and ran `release check` by hand, with fake gh scripts on PATH, on this repo and on a scratch clone whose log I extended. CI gate: success passed; failure, in_progress (pending) and [] (no run) each FAIL with a reason; gh exiting 4 aborts with exit 1. Soak: a missing -runs file fails with 'not in the daemon run history'; a 30h/48h-old first run fails because a bug request came after; the earliest of duplicate lines counts; RHIZA_RELEASE_RUNS works as the default; a malformed line errors with file:line. Patch: a v0.2.1 tag 1 minute old fails 'last patch was 1m0s ago'. Severe: a 'severe: data loss on land' note on the bug fix gives soak and patch 'skipped' (ready even with HEAD missing from the history), and a red CI still blocks. Milestone: a blocking question on a serving change set fails the gate (lists which-frob) and passes once an answers link lands. Minor: -commit is not resolved to a SHA, and the in-flight check can never fire.

QA at 8ff82f55d: ran the built `release check` by hand. On this repo it reports v0.2.0 minor since v0.1.0 (two detected setting breaks, so breaking before v1 is a minor). On a scratch clone tagged v0.2.0: only a landed bug fix gives v0.2.1 patch; after tagging v0.2.1 it gives v0.2.2; a change set with a 'breaking: removes --old' note gives v0.3.0 minor (pre-v1); tagging v1.0.0 makes it v2.0.0 major; with nothing landed since the tag it reports 'none: no release since v0.2.0'.

QA at 8ff82f55d: ran the built `release check` by hand. On this repo the draft notes list the detected breaking changes, then a section per finished milestone (m32-*, m33-*) with each change set's intent and the milestone's statement, then the bug fixes. On a scratch clone: the bug fix appears under Bug fixes, flagged '(severe: data loss on land)' once the note is added; a landed record change set is left out; a breaking-marked change set appears under Breaking changes with its title and reason ('Add the frobnicator: removes --old'), and under its milestone heading 'Milestone qa-milestone: Frobnication everywhere' with the other serving change set.
